test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Until recently, 3D printing has been sugar-based, but technology is emerging that reliably prints __savoury__ and fresh ingredients.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Sweet'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• "**Savoury**" means salty or spicy rather than sweet. (चटपटा)
 
• The correct antonym is "**Sweet**," which means having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey; not salty, sour, or bitter. (मीठा)
